title: CPSC Product Recalls API — US Consumer Product Recall Watch
desc: US product recalls from the CPSC database by product words and date, or only new and updated ones: products, hazards, injuries, remedy, firms and the recall page; failed or unchanged rows are never charged. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC).

title: NHTSA Recall, Complaint & Safety Spike Monitor

Get severity scores, crash/fire/injury/death signals, before/after context, and auditable spike math. Stateful baselines prevent historical records from appearing as new.

title: NHTSA Safety Ratings Scraper - Vehicle Scores

title: Australia ACCC Product Recalls Scraper
desc: Scrape Australian ACCC product recalls: product, supplier, hazard, remedy and recall date from the official register. Every run returns the current records as a dataset. Optional watch mode returns only what changed since your last run. Pay per result.

title: Product Recall Scraper — CPSC Safety Recalls
desc: Scrape official US CPSC product safety recalls: recall number and date, product, units affected, hazard, injuries reported, remedy (refund, repair, replace), recalling firm, importers, country of manufacture, where it was sold and product images. Filter by date, product or keyword. No API key.

title: NHTSA Vehicle Recalls & Complaints Scraper
desc: Collects NHTSA vehicle safety recall records and consumer complaints filtered by make, model, and model year. Returns each recall or complaint as a structured flat row with official defect and remedy details.

title: NHTSA Recall & Defect Investigation Tracker API

title: CPSC Recall Lookup

title: CPSC Product Recalls & Safety Tracker API

title: Consumer Product Recall Tracker (CPSC)
desc: US consumer product recalls from the CPSC: product, hazard, remedy, injuries, units, UPCs, manufacturers and the retailers that sold them, with brand/UPC/retailer watchlists for sellers and daily monitoring.
